shots.subject: nobody@51,51
shots.why: Rule as image on frame 0: kids pull swords free, tags pop; centre frame the hero strains, tag Nobody.

shots.subject: nobody@58,42
shots.why: Meet the hero: twelve, still straining.

shots.subject: nobody@56,53
shots.why: His tag is the rule made visible: Nobody.
Birth: a stone rises out of the field with a sword inside.
Your sword is stuck inside it.

shots.subject: kidA@50,36
shots.why: Pull it out: sword free, sparkle, a name pops above the head.
Baker. Knight. Even King: three tags pop on the beat; most kids do it by seven.

shots.subject: pip@50,27
shots.why: His little sister: tiny, one hand on the hilt.

shots.subject: pip@48,41
shots.why: With one hand, while eating bread: smug, tag pops Pip (laugh 1).

shots.subject: nobody@55,45
shots.why: Every morning, alone in the field, he pulls.

shots.subject: nobody@59,53
shots.why: The counter ticks past two thousand tries.
The hilt does not move an inch.

shots.subject: nobody@43,40
shots.why: The other kids made it a game: they gather and point.

shots.subject: kidBaker@52,47
shots.why: Taunt as a chat bubble (Need a hand?) over his shoulder; he never answers.

shots.subject: nobody@50,37
shots.why: Gamecam: next day he walks back to his stone like a player.

shots.subject: nobody@76,39
shots.why: He wasn't strong: strains, slips, falls back.

shots.subject: nobody@39,39
shots.why: Too stubborn to stop: grabs the hilt again.

shots.subject: king@34,52
shots.why: The law: the King at the gate, knights, a Nobody leaving.

shots.subject: exile@35,39
shots.why: You leave the kingdom forever: a grown Nobody walks away.

shots.subject: nobody@50,58
shots.why: One day left: a bar over his head almost empty.

shots.subject: nobody@50,33
shots.why: Nobodies sleep outside: he walks away from the closed gate at dusk.

shots.subject: nobody@36,48
shots.why: Night: every night he sleeps on the grass next to his stone.
Clue 1: hairline cracks in the dirt at the stone base (morning).
Clue 2 (wider): he pulls, the cracks have grown.
Clue 3 (widest): the ground around the stone is split open.

shots.subject: nobody@54,44
shots.why: He thought it was just the cold: shivering.

shots.subject: nobody@35,53
shots.why: That last night the sky turns orange over the town.
A dragon lands on the castle wall above the town.
Up close: it rears over the square, its head above the chapel steeple.
The knights charge; fire; their swords melt like candles.

shots.subject: king@50,43
shots.why: The king's sword melted too: he gapes.
Everyone runs; his sister trips on the cobbles.

shots.subject: pip@71,55
shots.why: The dragon brings its huge face down to her: she is tiny on the cobbles.

shots.subject: nobody@49,43
shots.why: The boy had no sword: alone in the firelit field, empty hands.

shots.subject: nobody@22,36
shots.why: He ran to his stone and grabbed the handle (low angle).

shots.subject: nobody@62,54
shots.why: Pulled harder than ever: shake, dust, the cracks open (low).

shots.subject: nobody@49,52
shots.why: TWIST: the whole stone rips free: flash, dust burst (biggest change).

shots.subject: nobody@55,43
shots.why: He stands holding it: slow orbit, low angle.
A handle; a giant block of rock on the end.

shots.subject: nobody@43,44
shots.why: He finally understood: gasp, then a small smile.

shots.subject: nobody@47,53
shots.why: It was never a sword in a stone; it was a hammer (glow, orbit).

shots.subject: nobody@50,40
shots.why: Gamecam run through the square: fire hits the stone and splits in two; stone doesn't melt.

shots.subject: nobody@47,47
shots.why: He steps in front of his sister; winds up one swing.
BONK on the nose: squash, stars, flash (cartoon).
It blinks, whimpers, and flies away crying.

shots.subject: nobody@41,44
shots.why: The whole kingdom went silent: everyone stares at him.

shots.subject: pip@50,34
shots.why: Pip yells That's my brother! (bubble).

shots.subject: nobody@78,50
shots.why: Next morning: the King offers any name; confetti, crowd.

shots.subject: king@50,48
shots.why: Dragonbreaker? Sir Hammer? Anything! (bubbles over the King).

shots.subject: nobody@50,44
shots.why: The boy looks up at his tag.

shots.subject: nobody@50,51
shots.why: It still said Nobody. He kept it.

shots.subject: nobody@40,47
shots.why: Bookend: the field by day again, kids at their stones.

shots.subject: nobody@52,43
shots.why: He never did: the hammer held high, a grin.

shots.subject: nobody@44,49
shots.why: Rhymes with frame 0: every kid tag flips to Nobody; they try to lift whole stones.
